## Purpose

Git commit skill using conventional commits. Part of the PaulRBerg/agent-skills set at audited pinned commit. Assists in crafting proper commit messages and workflows for git contributions. Complements other dev-automation skills like bump-release, yeet (GitHub contribs).

## Upstream Maintainer

PaulRBerg (github.com/PaulRBerg/agent-skills, pinned commit d3f5540). MIT License. Author also maintains dot-claude, dot-agents, and related tooling for agentic workflows.
